reason: 该插件的主要面向用户价值在于在 DeepSeek Harness Web 中提供 PR 工作流看板，集中展示和处理我方与待评审 PR 的状态与任务，因此核心目的是自动化软件协作与发布流程。README 明确列出了 PR 监控、CI/评审状态、冲突与落后处理、一键或自动化修复动作，以及可配置执行器的任务控制能力；因此其主分类应为自动化而非单纯开发、搜索或文档处理类能力。

summaries.zh: 这是一个集成在 DeepSeek Harness Web 的 PR 工作流插件，用于看板化管理与追踪你的 PR 与评审状态，并提供任务驱动的自动化处理入口。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that provides a dashboard view for tracking pull requests and reviews, with controls for workflow automation around PR-related tasks.

capabilities: Track and monitor pull request/review status in a local web panel
Create and manage local git worktrees for repositories and synchronize branch state
Automate handling of conflicts, CI issues, and review-related tasks via local workers
Run and control background jobs with start/steer/pause/continue/terminate actions
Interact with GitHub-related workflows over the network through local CLI/service integration

reasons.code: README describes PR, Reviews, Jobs, Logs, and automated actions for conflict/CI/review handling
README describes local daemon service, local clone directories, branch syncing, and worker configuration
Package manifest defines a web plugin client entry and CLI command for running the local service
